== English errata comparison sources ==
The Dark host’s two panels replace the relocation after a character was hit with relocation when a character is about to be hit. The 2007 captured Dark face shows the original wording. The two Dark Force icons, one Light Force icon, Interior, Mobile, Scomp Link and Dark artwork remain unchanged. The separate Light host retains its own face, Force icons and references.
